serie: Loretta's Church Kitchen: an 81-year-old Iowa church lady cooks the church supper recipes of her little cookbook, one page each, in her farmhouse kitchen and the basement kitchen of her church
acciones: stirring a pot, sliding a 9x13 pan into the oven, lifting a lid, tasting from a wooden spoon, carrying a covered dish, setting a long church supper table, slicing potatoes into a bowl
estilo: One ordinary frame pulled from a normal handheld video shot by her grandson with a phone at eye level, in the middle of the action: framing casual and a little off, something cut by the edge of the frame, almost everything in focus and nothing blurred out, only the light the place really has (a ceiling bulb, a lamp or the daylight from the window), automatic white balance a bit off, slight phone noise, ordinary worn objects of an old Iowa farmhouse, plain bottles and rags with no labels, no beautiful composition.

loretta.desc: Loretta, an 81-year-old white American grandmother with short curly snow-white hair, thin wire-rimmed glasses, a lilac button-up blouse, a small pearl necklace and a faded floral cotton apron, with old wrinkled hands

lugares_fijos.cocina: Loretta's 1950s white farmhouse kitchen: a white enamel stove with chrome handles, yellow gingham curtains on the window, a small wooden cross on the wall, a wall calendar, a worn wooden table with a flour canister on the counter
lugares_fijos.sotano: the church basement kitchen of Zion United Methodist: long folding tables with white paper tablecloths, a big steel stove and a pass-through window, stacks of plain white plates, aluminum roasting pans, a coffee urn on the counter
lugares_fijos.nevera: Loretta's old white refrigerator with a freezer door, a bowl under plastic wrap, a 9x13 covered glass dish on the middle shelf
lugares_fijos.mesa: a church supper table in a fellowship hall: folding tables, plain paper tablecloths, covered dishes, a plain glass water pitcher

identidad: Preserve the exact identity, face, short curly snow-white hair, thin wire-rimmed glasses, age and skin of the elderly woman in the reference photograph. She wears a lilac button-up blouse, a small pearl necklace and a faded floral cotton apron.
